name: Update member contact information
description: Updates a member's e-mail, phone and mailing address. All three are required: the form saves every field it holds, so a value left out would be blanked. Read the current values first with the read-member-record capability.

inputParams.name: email
inputParams.description: New e-mail address. Required: the form saves all three fields together.

inputParams.name: phone
inputParams.description: New phone number. Required: the form saves all three fields together.

inputParams.name: address
inputParams.description: New mailing address. Required: the form saves all three fields together.
